NFL DFS Projections Week 7: DraftKings Picks, Values and Sim Plays

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 25 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 25, 3:07 PM ET

Jahmyr Gibbs carries the highest SPAGS model projection on the Week 7 DraftKings main slate: 30.8 DraftKings points at $9,800. He also holds 36% of the simulated winning-lineup credit across 10,000 simulations, more than any other player on the slate, with Christian McCaffrey second at 32% for $7,600.

Behind Gibbs, the model's next four projections are Bijan Robinson (27.3, $8,500), Christian McCaffrey (23.3, $7,600), Kyren Williams (21.7, $7,000) and Puka Nacua (21.0, $8,400). Bijan Robinson returns the most per dollar of that group at 3.21 projected points per $1,000. Puka Nacua leads the wide receivers at 21.0 for $8,400, Jared Goff leads the quarterbacks at 20.5 for $6,800, and Brock Bowers leads the tight ends at 17.3 for $7,700.

The 10-game slate runs from a 55.5-point total in GB at DET down to 36.5 in CLE at TEN. Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 25, 3:07 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup credit comes from 10,000 simulations of the contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th.

Quarterbacks: Week 7 DraftKings projections

Jared Goff, DET vs GB ($6,800)

Jared Goff carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 20.5 DraftKings points at $6,800. That is 0.6 points clear of Brock Purdy. The salary works out to 3.01 projected points per $1,000, 12th of 17 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Goff averaged 20.3 points with a simulated floor of 7.7 and a ceiling of 37.3, and he holds 8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Detroit is a 3.5-point favorite at home against Green Bay, with an implied team total of 29.5 in a game totaled at 55.5.

Brock Purdy, SF at ATL ($6,600)

Brock Purdy projects 2nd at the position with 19.9 DraftKings points at $6,600. The model includes 4.2 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 3.01 projected points per $1,000, 13th of 17 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Purdy averaged 19.9 points with a simulated floor of 7.4 and a ceiling of 36.3, and he holds 7% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. San Francisco is a 2.5-point favorite on the road against Atlanta, with an implied team total of 26 in a game totaled at 49.5.

Value: Tyler Huntley, BAL vs CIN ($4,900)

Tyler Huntley projects for 17.4 DraftKings points at $4,900, which works out to 3.54 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 17 quarterbacks the model projects for 15 or more points. The model includes 4.4 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Huntley averaged 17.4 points with a simulated floor of 6.9 and a ceiling of 31.7, and he holds 5% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Baltimore is a 3-point underdog at home against Cincinnati, with an implied team total of 21.75 in a game totaled at 46.5.

Woody Marks projects for 17.4 DraftKings points at $5,600, which works out to 3.10 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 21 running backs the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 22.2 carries and 2.4 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Marks averaged 17.4 points with a simulated floor of 7.6 and a ceiling of 32.6, and he holds 21% of the simulated winning-lineup credit.
